issue.body:
Compile this:

```
#include <algorithm>
int a;
extern short b[][1][1];
void c(int d[][1][1], short e[][1][1]) {
  for (int f;;)
    for (int g;; g += 3LL)
      if (d)
        for (int h; h < 2036854775797ULL; h += 4ULL)
          for (int i(-49); i < 10; i++) {
            b[h][g][g] = d[f][g][g] | std::min(0, d[0][f][g]);
            a = std::max((unsigned long long)e[0][1][1],
                         (unsigned long long)401598999);
          }
}
```
